title: THINK TWICE!!
text: THINK TWICE!!. Made three 'pots' of coffee and now the plunger just goes sideways and does not filter the grounds - what a huge waste of money!  Further, the 'legs' around the glass portion are uneven and the coffee maker is unstable!  I should have known when opening box and everything was in Chinese!  Will never again buy from this seller.  At the price I paid, each batch cost around $10, so $5 a cup- WOW!  Also, if you were hoping for the VIDEO BONUS that was advertised - do not hold your breath!  Nothing included and no mention of it.  Thankfully the internet has a ton - too bad I don't have a way to make coffee now!
